source: Own measurement, 2026-11-19, on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/episodes.json: draw 1, 12 episodes, 2 per unit; amendment 1 in tests/hidden/episode_selection.json) with this build's grader and credit (a listed jar counts when it holds exactly the listed pieces and is closed again): the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth) through the pinned engine (vendor/ale bfb7505), one ale validate from a clean checkout after the maintainer fixes, validate-3e4b0709: mean_episode_credit 1.0, 12 of 12 episodes scored with both listed jars done, no simulation faults, the numerics fingerprint and the render self-test passed, untouched 0.0, probe pairs 601 of 601 differing, 4228-5830 steps per episode, the reference's own time 233 s of the 9000 s budget, the verify stage 4004 s. A second validate of the same tree on a host of another CPU family (validate-2386795b) took the same number of steps in every episode. Before the fixes, under the summed credit and without the kernel pin: five validates by the author, 1.0 in each.
note: Measured, not drawn. The set holds only episodes on which the reference scored credit 1.0 in three runs over the real wire when it was selected (tests/hidden/episode_selection.json), and all twelve again in the amendment's verify. full_at 0.98: with the kernel pinned the reference repeats step for step on every host, so there is no spread to cover; one listed jar lost (half of one episode, 0.042 of the metric) would read reward 0.98.
